issues.body: Sections 3.1 and 9 still claim that a self-improvement follow-up issue was filed, but cite only the custom dedupe marker `noir-acir-unroll-2026-07-28`. This is materially identical to the round-4 finding: a search marker is neither the issue's durable tracker identifier nor evidence that the claimed issue exists, leaving the disposition unauditable from the research record.
issues.fix_hint: Replace or supplement the dedupe marker with the actual issue number or URL in the Section 3.1 disposition and Section 9 status entry. If no issue was filed, file the scoped issue first and cite its resulting durable identifier.
issues.title: Filed ACIR follow-up still lacks its durable issue identifier

verdict.summary: Round 5 is stagnant. The round-4 major auditability defect remains unchanged: the new research record repeatedly says a self-improvement issue was filed, but identifies it only by the author-created search marker `noir-acir-unroll-2026-07-28`. A dedupe/search phrase is not the durable issue number or URL, does not establish that the issue exists, and does not let a reader reliably trace the claimed disposition.
